anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning correctly.
Trading system shows zero active trades and zero total profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Evaluate AI system configuration and data inputs to ensure it is operating and generating trading opportunities as expected.
Review trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they are aligned and capable of generating trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is functioning correctly and capable of generating trading opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system is not generating learning cycles or opportunities, which may hinder trading performance.
